title: Business verification for every store
problem: Staff could not check a store's trade licence, TIN or owner's NID, and nothing showed which stores were real.
now: Owners send their licence, TIN, NID and photos from Settings; staff approve or reject them in a review queue, and the state shows everywhere.
steps: In the merchant panel open Settings › Business verification and send the form with two photos
In the super admin open Merchants › Verification and approve or reject it
Open Dazzle Shop's profile and see the Verification card
Back in Settings the shop shows Verified or the reason it was rejected
notes: Where: Merchant: Settings › Business verification (/set-verification) · Super admin: Merchants › Verification (/admin/kyc), merchant profile · Needs the server: Photos are kept as file names only; a server must store the files and check the numbers.

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
